title: Deeper/broader AC1027+ DataStorage reader and modeler-disposition cross-check
mode: Primary-source open-source project review plus local plan audit; research-only plan update
scope: Reassess the optional independent structural-reader route for R2013+ DWG AcDsPrototype_1b DataStorage.
Separate whole-section parsing, entity-to-payload association, DXF/DWG writer behavior, opaque payload preservation, and ACIS geometry semantics.
Translate peer-reported section edge cases into bounded, fast local test requirements without adding fixtures or changing support claims.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web review and local plan review; research receipt and plan edited
method.limitations: All comparator behavior is based on public release, source, pull-request, issue, and documentation statements. The exact ACadSharp package/source artifact was not installed or executed. Peer corpus comparisons are contributor-reported and were not independently reproduced. No sample payload was downloaded.

sources.observed: PR #1154 merged on 2026-07-28 and is listed in the v3.6.51 release history. It replaces the earlier DWG ACIS signature-extraction route with a structured Prototype1b section reader. The PR author describes the model as a low-level full-section parser whose entries are not yet straightforward to edit because related schema/search/index records must remain linked. A contributor reported a 423-DWG corpus comparison and refined it from total extracted counts to referenced per-handle payload hashes; the thread reports an offset-anchor correction and a stale secondary segment-index exception case. ACadSharp issue #1195 reports DXF writer omission of 3DSOLID/REGION in v3.4.9, while linked writer PR #1240 remains branch-level in the inspected pull-request/release views.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A distinct implementation family and a candidate for pinned structural comparison of AcDs records. Public reports do not independently qualify current package behavior, complete entity wiring, writer support, arbitrary payloads, B-rep semantics, or native consumer acceptance.

sources.observed: The documentation distinguishes DXF SAT payloads for R2000-R2010 from SAB payloads for R2013 and later, provides raw ACIS inspection/export, and says creation of ACIS payloads requires an external library.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A bounded version-matched DXF carrier inspection route, not a general ACIS kernel or DWG AcDs ownership validator. API documentation was not exercised against a pinned package.

sources.observed: The public LibreDWG-maintained spec diff identifies AcDb:AcDsPrototype_1b as a new R2013 data-storage section containing ACIS-related information; repository AGENTS.md designates local ODA v5.4.1 as authoritative for DWG byte-layout decisions.
sources.evidenceCeiling: The public diff is contextual corroboration only. No DWG field-layout conclusion or change to the authoritative local spec was made in this plan-only pass.

assessment.planEffect: Add ACadSharp v3.6.51-or-later as an optional pinned structural reader for one composed AC1027+ comparison; compare referenced owner/handle records and bytes rather than global payload counts; add fast generated DataStorage controls for bounds/index/page and missing-entity-association cases; retain separate carrier, structural, semantic, and native evidence gates.
